name: delay doubles per consecutive failure, is capped, then jittered upward by up to 20%
source: packages/sdk-core/src/client.ts armBackoff() — exp = min(retryBaseMs * 2^(failures-1), retryCapMs); jitter = exp * 0.2 * random(). The cap applies BEFORE the jitter, so the true maximum delay is capMs * 1.2. The schedule is an implementation choice with no external authority, so this vector exists to pin it for the port rather than to judge it.
